inputs.55.value:
[Verse]
One small spark in the endless night
Cupped by hands against the cold
Passed along from heart to heart
A promise someone had to hold

[Chorus]
Carry the fire, carry it on
Through every night until the dawn
Hand to hand and year to year
We carry the fire, we carry it here

[Verse]
Smoke on the river, chains on the land
Long roads walked in silent tears
Brother turned on brother's hand
Empty tables, empty years

[Chorus]
Carry the fire, don't let it die
When the whole world burns beneath the sky
Hand to hand and year to year
We carry the fire, we carry it here

[Bridge]
Just a candle in the window
Just a flicker, just a flame
Someone waiting in the darkness
Someone whispering our name

[Chorus]
Carry the fire, lift it high
Light the engines, split the sky
Hand to hand and year to year
We carried the fire, and now we're here

[Outro]
One small spark in the endless night
Now a footprint on the moon
